info.title: gitlab-mcp-server — GitLab MCP Server
info.description: GitLab MCP server: GitLab REST v4 and GraphQL as Model Context Protocol tools. A .NET tool wrapping the native Go binary; install with dotnet tool install or run with dnx.

x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription:
A Model Context Protocol (MCP) server that exposes GitLab operations
as MCP tools, resources, and prompts for AI assistants.
Supports stdio (default) and HTTP transport modes.

options.name: -help
options.description: Show this help message

options.name: -version
options.description: Print version and exit

options.name: -shutdown
options.description: Terminate all running instances and exit

options.name: -env-file
options.description:
Dotenv file to load besides ~/.gitlab-mcp-server.env; the same setting as
GITLAB_MCP_ENV_FILE, and wins over it

options.name: -probe
options.description:
Ask the running instance's /health and exit 0 when it answers (the container
HEALTHCHECK). The listener is read off that instance's own flags, a TLS one
pinned to its -tls-cert; a URL, unix:<path> or host:port after the flag
probes that instead, an https one pinned to -tls-cert when given before it

options.name: -tool-search
options.description:
Search the action catalog by name, alias, tag or description and exit. Prints
each canonical action ID, which is what gitlab_execute_action takes, beside the
tool the configured surface names it. The surface and the tier come from
-tool-surface and -tier when passed, and otherwise from GITLAB_MCP_TOOL_SURFACE
and GITLAB_MCP_TIER, so a stdio deployment searches what it serves

options.name: -log-level
options.description: Logging verbosity: debug|info|warn|error (default info)

options.name: -pprof-addr
options.description:
Serve Go's profiling handlers (net/http/pprof) on this loopback address, e.g.
127.0.0.1:6060, on a listener of their own, started before the transport.
Empty (default) serves nothing; an address that is not loopback is refused
Transport

options.name: -transport
options.description:
Transport to serve: stdio|http|auto. Empty defers to -http; given both, -transport
wins. auto reads file descriptor 0: HTTP only when stdin is the null device, which
is what a container started without -i gives, and stdio for the pipe an MCP client
connects

options.name: -http
options.description: Run in HTTP transport mode (default: stdio)

options.name: -http-addr
options.description: Listen address: host:port, or a path to bind a unix socket (default ":8080")

options.name: -http-socket-mode
options.description: Octal permission mode for a unix socket (default "0660")

options.name: -tls-cert
options.description: PEM certificate; serves HTTPS on the listener (requires -tls-key)

options.name: -tls-key
options.description: PEM private key matching -tls-cert

options.name: -stateless
options.description: Stateless streamable HTTP (default true; required for protocol 2026-07-28)

options.name: -json-response
options.description:
Return application/json responses instead of SSE (default false)
-max-request-body-bytes n Maximum streamable HTTP request body bytes (0 = SDK default 4 MiB)
-session-timeout duration Idle MCP session timeout; -stateless=false only (default 30m0s)

options.name: -http-idle-timeout
options.description:
HTTP server idle connection timeout; 0 (default) disables idle closure
GitLab connection

options.name: -gitlab-url
options.description:
GitLab URL, required in HTTP mode. Repeatable to publish several instances, which a
GITLAB-URL header then selects among

options.name: -allow-any-gitlab-url
options.description:
Let the GITLAB-URL header name any host when -gitlab-url publishes none. Every request
is then served against a host the caller chose, so -http-addr must bind a loopback
address or a unix socket

options.name: -skip-tls-verify
options.description: Skip TLS certificate verification when calling GitLab (default false)

options.name: -tier
options.description: Force licensing tier: free|ce|premium|ultimate; omit to detect per server entry

options.name: -ignore-scopes
options.description: Skip PAT scope detection, register all tools (default false)

options.name: -upload-max-file-size
options.description:
Maximum size in bytes for upload and file-read tools (default 2GB)
The GitLab token has no flag, on purpose: a token on a command line is
visible to every user on the machine through ps and lands in shell history.
Set GITLAB_TOKEN in the environment, or send it per request in HTTP mode.
Tool surface

options.name: -tool-surface
options.description: Tool surface: dynamic|meta|individual (default dynamic)

options.name: -capability-surface
options.description: Capability surface: full|minimal (default full)

options.name: -meta-param-schema
options.description: Meta-tool input schema mode: opaque|compact|full (default opaque)

options.name: -embedded-resources
options.description: Embed canonical MCP resource links in get_* tool results (default true)

options.name: -exclude-tools
options.description: Comma-separated tool names to exclude from registration

options.name: -client-compat
options.description:
Per-client response compatibility: auto|off (default auto)
Protective modes

options.name: -read-only
options.description: Expose only read-only tools (default false)

options.name: -safe-mode
options.description: Intercept mutating tools and return a preview instead of executing

options.name: -yolo-mode
options.description:
Skip the confirmation prompt on destructive actions (default false; overrides AUTOPILOT)
Authentication (HTTP mode)

options.name: -auth-mode
options.description: Authentication mode: legacy|oauth (default "legacy")

options.name: -public-url
options.description:
Externally reachable https origin; required with -auth-mode=oauth
-oauth-cache-ttl duration OAuth token cache TTL (default 15m0s, min 1m0s, max 2h0m0s)

options.name: -oauth-client-uid
options.description: Comma-separated GitLab OAuth application uids whose tokens are admitted (default: any)

options.name: -revalidate-interval
options.description:
How often pooled tokens are re-validated against GitLab (default 15m0s; 0 stops the
periodic check, but an entry whose credential is older than 1h0m0s is still rebuilt,
which ends any stateful session on it)

options.name: -resource-documentation
options.description: https URL published as RFC 9728 resource_documentation (default: this project's HTTP server mode page)

options.name: -resource-policy-uri
options.description: https URL published as RFC 9728 resource_policy_uri (default: omitted)

options.name: -resource-tos-uri
options.description:
https URL published as RFC 9728 resource_tos_uri (default: omitted)
Limits and pooling (HTTP mode)

options.name: -max-http-clients
options.description: Maximum unique (token, GitLab URL) pool entries; not sessions or concurrent requests (default 100)

options.name: -pool-idle-timeout
options.description: Reclaim a pooled credential entry after this long unused, except one with a live subscription (default 1h0m0s, 0 to disable)

options.name: -action-timeout
options.description: Cancel an action still running after this long (default 65m, 0 to disable)

options.name: -drain-delay
options.description:
After SIGTERM, answer /health with 503 draining for this long before closing the
listener, so a balancer takes the instance out first (default 0: close at once)

options.name: -rate-limit-rps
options.description:
Per-credential rate limit on every call that reaches GitLab, plus tools/list on
a bucket of its own refilled a tenth as fast (default 10; 0 disables it)

options.name: -rate-limit-burst
options.description: Token-bucket burst size when -rate-limit-rps > 0 (default 40)

options.name: -trusted-origins
options.description:
Origins allowed to make cross-origin browser requests ('*' accepts any; empty rejects all)
-trusted-proxy-header str HTTP header with real client IP (e.g. X-Forwarded-For, X-Real-IP); requires -trusted-proxies

options.name: -trusted-proxies
options.description:
Addresses or CIDR ranges of the proxies that header is believed from (e.g. 127.0.0.1,10.0.0.0/8)
Telemetry

options.name: -telemetry
options.description: Export OpenTelemetry traces, metrics and logs over OTLP (default false)

options.name: -telemetry-identity
options.description: What telemetry records about the caller: none|pseudonymous|full (default none)

options.name: -telemetry-identity-rotation
options.description: How long a generated pseudonymisation key lives, e.g. 24h (empty keeps it for the process)

options.name: -telemetry-tool-name
options.description:
Whether the tool name is a metric dimension: auto|on|off (default auto:
on for dynamic and meta, off for individual, where ~1000 tools would
exhaust the cardinality limit and collapse the long tail)
Off by default, and it goes to a collector you configure through the
standard OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_* environment; nothing is ever sent anywhere
else. OTEL_SDK_DISABLED=true vetoes it regardless of the flag. See
docs/guides/telemetry.md.
ENVIRONMENT VARIABLES (stdio mode)
Settings this project defines are read as GITLAB_MCP_<NAME>. The unprefixed
spelling of a renamed variable still works and is removed in 3.1.0; when both
are set the prefixed one wins and a warning names the one being ignored.
GITLAB_URL and GITLAB_TOKEN keep their bare names, and so does every OTEL_*
variable, which the OpenTelemetry exporters read themselves.
GITLAB_URL                        GitLab instance URL (default: https://gitlab.com; set for self-managed instances)
GITLAB_TOKEN                      Personal Access Token (glpat-...)
GITLAB_MCP_SKIP_TLS_VERIFY        Skip TLS verification: true/false (default false)
GITLAB_MCP_TOOL_SURFACE           Canonical tool surface: dynamic|meta|individual (default dynamic)
GITLAB_MCP_CAPABILITY_SURFACE     Resource/prompt surface: full|minimal (default full)
GITLAB_MCP_META_PARAM_SCHEMA      Meta-tool input schema: opaque|compact|full (default opaque)
GITLAB_MCP_TIER                   Force licensing tier: free|ce|premium|ultimate; omit to detect from license
GITLAB_MCP_READ_ONLY              Expose only read-only tools: true/false (default false)
GITLAB_MCP_SAFE_MODE              Intercept mutating tools and return a preview (default false)
GITLAB_MCP_EMBEDDED_RESOURCES     Embed canonical MCP resource links in get_* results (default true)
GITLAB_MCP_EXCLUDE_TOOLS          Comma-separated tool names to exclude (default empty)
GITLAB_MCP_IGNORE_SCOPES          Skip PAT scope detection: true/false (default false)
GITLAB_MCP_UPLOAD_MAX_FILE_SIZE   Maximum upload/file size for upload tools (default 2GB)
GITLAB_MCP_RATE_LIMIT_RPS         Per-credential rate limit on every call that reaches GitLab, plus
tools/list on a bucket refilled a tenth as fast (default 0, disabled)
GITLAB_MCP_RATE_LIMIT_BURST       Token-bucket burst size when the rate limit is on (default 40)
GITLAB_MCP_STDIO_MAX_LINE_BYTES   Longest stdio message accepted, in bytes (default 4 MiB). Raise it
only for a client that inlines large base64 payloads; a longer line
is refused, not buffered
GITLAB_MCP_MAX_LISTEN_STREAMS     Concurrent subscriptions/listen streams one credential may hold open
(default 64; 0 disables the per-credential ceiling). Both transports
GITLAB_MCP_ALLOW_PRIVATE_INSTANCES
Permit a private, loopback or CGNAT address as a destination this
server's operator did not choose: an instance a caller named in
GITLAB-URL under --allow-any-gitlab-url, or a redirect hop that left
the configured instance (default false). An address GITLAB_URL named
is never checked; cloud metadata addresses are always refused
GITLAB_MCP_YOLO_MODE              Skip destructive action confirmation prompts (default false)
GITLAB_MCP_DESCRIPTION_SUBSTITUTIONS
Rewrite listed descriptions and titles for strict gateway validators:
comma-separated old=new pairs, backslash escapes \, \= \\ (default empty)
GITLAB_MCP_TELEMETRY              Export OpenTelemetry traces, metrics and logs over OTLP (default false)
GITLAB_MCP_TELEMETRY_IDENTITY     What telemetry records about the caller: none|pseudonymous|full
(default none)
GITLAB_MCP_TELEMETRY_IDENTITY_KEY
Secret the pseudonymous policy derives its keys from; environment
only, no flag
GITLAB_MCP_TELEMETRY_IDENTITY_ROTATION
How long a generated pseudonymisation key lives, e.g. 24h
(default: process lifetime)
GITLAB_MCP_TELEMETRY_TOOL_NAME    Whether gen_ai.tool.name is a metric dimension: auto|on|off
(default auto)
GITLAB_MCP_LOG_LEVEL              Logging: debug/info/warn/error (default info)
GITLAB_MCP_PPROF_ADDR             Loopback address for Go's profiling handlers, e.g. 127.0.0.1:6060
(default empty: nothing served). Both transports
ENVIRONMENT VARIABLES (HTTP mode)
Every HTTP flag that has a variable, above or below, reads it when the flag
is not passed. Precedence: an explicitly passed flag, then the environment,
then the built-in default. The variables below have no stdio equivalent:
GITLAB_MCP_AUTH_MODE              Authentication mode: legacy|oauth (default legacy)
GITLAB_MCP_PUBLIC_URL             Externally reachable https origin; required with oauth auth mode
GITLAB_MCP_TRUSTED_ORIGINS        Origins allowed to make cross-origin browser requests
GITLAB_MCP_OAUTH_CACHE_TTL        OAuth token cache TTL (default 15m, min 1m, max 2h)
GITLAB_MCP_OAUTH_CLIENT_UID       Comma-separated GitLab OAuth application uids whose tokens are
admitted (default: any)
GITLAB_MCP_MAX_HTTP_CLIENTS       Maximum unique (token, GitLab URL) pool entries; not sessions
(default 100)
GITLAB_MCP_SESSION_TIMEOUT        Idle MCP session timeout; --stateless=false only (default 30m)
GITLAB_MCP_POOL_IDLE_TIMEOUT      Reclaim an unused pooled server after this long (default 1h, 0 disables)
GITLAB_MCP_ACTION_TIMEOUT         Cancel an action still running after this long, both transports
(default 65m, 0 disables)
GITLAB_MCP_DRAIN_DELAY            After SIGTERM, answer /health with 503 draining this long before closing
the listener (default 0)
GITLAB_MCP_SESSION_REVALIDATE_INTERVAL
Token re-validation interval (default 15m; 0 stops the periodic
check, an entry older than 1h is still rebuilt)
JSON CONFIGURATION EXAMPLES
VS Code / GitHub Copilot (.vscode/mcp.json):
{
"servers": {
"gitlab": {
"type": "stdio",
"command": "/usr/local/bin/gitlab-mcp-server",
"env": {
"GITLAB_URL": "https://gitlab.example.com",
"GITLAB_TOKEN": "glpat-your-token",
"GITLAB_MCP_SKIP_TLS_VERIFY": "true",
"GITLAB_MCP_TOOL_SURFACE": "dynamic"
}
}
}
}
OpenCode (MCP configuration):
"mcpServers": {
"GITLAB_TOKEN": "glpat-your-token"
HTTP mode (single GitLab instance):
gitlab-mcp-server --http --gitlab-url=https://gitlab.example.com --http-addr=:8080
HTTP mode with no instance published (loopback only; clients send GITLAB-URL per request):
gitlab-mcp-server --http --allow-any-gitlab-url --http-addr=127.0.0.1:8080
